# Vision

page

Why this page exists; see [Scenario](#scenario).

<a id="index--pitch"></a>

## Pitch

Press one button after a glass of water; in the evening see how many glasses there were today, without keeping the number in your head.

<a id="index--problem"></a>

## Problem

People lose count of the glasses of water they drank by evening.

<a id="index--who"></a>

## Who

One role: a person who tracks how much water they drank today, with one press per glass and the count always in sight.

<a id="index--not-doing"></a>

## Not doing

No undo and no history of past days.
